Method of Attack: Injected obfuscated code to load malware
Replaced legitimate jQuery Migrate plugin files on WordPress sites
Loaded malicious analytics.js script with obfuscated code
analytics.js redirects users to malicious URLs prompting to allow browser notifications or leading to fake surveys
Attempted to exploit WordPress CSRF tokens to make forged requests
Redirects users through a series of spam URLs and fake surveys
Potential for Magecart scams, credit card skimming, redirecting to scam sites, spam notifications, and unwanted browser extensions
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using jQuery Migrate plugin
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of files named jquery-migrate.js and jquery-migrate.min.js in ./wp-includes/js/jquery/ directory
Malicious analytics.js script with obfuscated code referencing /wp-admin/user-new.php and _wpnonce_create-user variable
